summary: Raise go.mod toolchain floor from go 1.26.5 to go 1.26.6 so standard-library vulnerability fixes (GO-2026-6218 net/url, GO-2026-6090 crypto/tls, GO-2026-5972 encoding/asn1, GO-2026-5026 net/http) are enforced; govulncheck in publish validate was failing on reachable stdlib traces.
reason: publish validate's govulncheck check reported 4 reachable standard-library vulnerabilities fixed only in go1.26.6. Matches the catalog precedent patch catalog-go-1264-vuln-floor.
validated_outcome: publish validate govulncheck check passes with go 1.26.6 (GOTOOLCHAIN=auto).
